text:
Alex Morgan: Heads up — we're pushing a change to the routing/telemetry header tomorrow that will rename `x-rw-route-meta` -> `x-rw-route-v2`. This will affect quota attribution and console dashboards.
Priya Patel: Can we gate it behind an SDK opt-in? lots of customers rely on current header for quota and we'd like a soft migration. :thinking:
Daniel Kim: Opt-in at SDK level fragments data. We need a server-side fallback that accepts the old header and maps it to the new model.
Sara Lopez: Console needs to display a 'partial telemetry' warning if we detect mixed headers during rollout. We can show a % of requests using v2.
Lucas Chen: I can add a proxy shim in the ingress layer that, when it sees `x-rw-route-meta`, maps to `x-rw-route-v2` and tags requests with `x-rw-mapped: legacy`. That buys time.
infra-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC (canary first 10% in us-east-1).
Alex Morgan: SDK owners — we'll need coordinated patches. Plan: Py/TS add automatic header emission with an explicit config toggle, Go require explicit opt-in (since many Go apps are infra-sensitive).
Priya Patel: I don't want implicit telemetry turned on for users without consent. Suggest client config: `RedwoodClient(..., telemetry={"enabled": False})` default false.
Daniel Kim: If default false, dashboards will be missing data and SLA tests will fail. How about default true but sampled at 1% and documented? Sampling reduces PII/volume.
Sara Lopez: Sampling + sampling-rate metric visible in console is good. Ops can increase sampling for canary customers.
Lucas Chen: From infra POV, we can tag sampled events with `x-rw-sample: 1%` and record sampling decision in logs.
Alex Morgan: Proposal summary: default telemetry ON, global sampling at 1%, opt-out via env `RWI_TELEMETRY=false` or client config `telemetry.enabled=false`. Server accepts old header for 12 months and maps it.
Priya Patel: OK on sampling if default ON, but require that SDKs document the opt-out and make it trivial to disable. Also ensure no user content is logged — only route-hash and model-id.
Daniel Kim: We need a clear migration note: bump minor for Py/TS, major? no, minor with breaking behavior documented. Go gets a minor but explicit API addition to avoid surprises. Add changelog entries and deprecation warning on old header in server logs.
Sara Lopez: I'll add a new dashboard tile showing v1 vs v2 traffic and a "migration health" panel (missing quota attribution flagged).
Lucas Chen: I'll implement the ingress shim and server fallback rule: `if x-rw-route-meta present && x-rw-route-v2 missing -> map & add x-rw-legacy-mapped` until 2027-03-22.
Alex Morgan: Action items - Py PR #1234 (auto header, telemetry opt-out config, doc), TS PR #4321 (same), Go PR #210 (explicit opt-in + docs), Console PR #900 (tile), Ingress PR #77 (shim).
Priya Patel: I'll draft migration doc and privacy blurb for the website.
Daniel Kim: Add release note about telemetry default and sampling. Also tests: end-to-end quota attribution tests and a staging job that flips sampling to 100% to verify mapping.
infra-bot: CI: PR checks queued for py/ts/go and ingress shims.
Sara Lopez: Let's canary for 2 weeks and monitor the "missing attribution" alerts.
Alex Morgan: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the canonical rollout discussion — post PR links here and ping when ready.
